notes:
More accurate send detection: after sending, the app now waits a little longer for
LinkedIn to process the message. Before, a message could be shown as failed even
though it had already been sent. If the app does not find the send button right
away, it keeps looking for a few seconds and checks whether the message already
went out.

Important: if a message is shown as failed, please check the LinkedIn chat before
sending it again, in case it did arrive.
